# Gramlot examples 0.2.4

## Changes

- Every page module `NN_name.js` exports `Page` and `Logic`. The JavaScript page
  uses both; the Python page `NN_name.py` takes `Logic` from the module beside it,
  as the core host does since `gramlot` 0.2.5. Pages without named methods export an
  empty `Logic`.
- The four logic companions (`08_freeze_aux.js`, `03_named_logic_aux.js`,
  `08_remote_source_aux.js`, `09_end_to_end_aux.js`) moved into their page modules.
- `build_gallery` and `buildGallery`: `routes[key].logic` is `NN_name_aux.js` when it
  exists, else `NN_name.js`. An environment page can still use a companion; the host
  reports a page with both.
- The wheel carries the page modules `NN_name.js`.
- The Python gallery shows the logic module under `Logic · NN_name.js`.

## Tests

- A browser job opens every page in Chromium through the core `FileHost` of Python
  and JavaScript (`scripts/serve_pages.py`, `scripts/serve_pages.mjs`) and calls the
  `Logic` of `b08`, `c03`, `c08` and `c09`; the `e10` and `e13` check runs on the
  same hosts.

## Environments

`gramlot-py-server` 0.2.1 and `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` 0.2.3 serve only `.css`
and `_aux.js` files below a pages folder. A page that takes its `Logic` from
`NN_name.js` needs an adapter that serves `.js` files there.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
- Node.js 22 or later, or Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
